CARTOColors database

Source: R/cartocolors.R
cartocolors.Rd

A dataset containing the information about the CARTOcolor palettes. Source: https://github.com/CartoDB/CartoColor/blob/5302a3d7245595251ea5dd90fc09efcb8d3254fb/cartocolor.js.

Usage

cartocolors

Format

A data frame with 34 rows and 13 variables:

  • Name: palette name

  • Type: palette type

  • n2 to n12: list columns containing the stored colors for each size
